implementation_state: Bandit and reward learning is being built on branch node/7e-2c-bandit as offline fitting plus a bandit selection rule with inspectable arm state and a safety evaluation that can refuse. Nothing installs a policy, and Action::Explore stays unreachable from the live router.
unblock_condition: Dispatched: implement offline bandit and reward learning with inspectable arm state, a tail-aware safety evaluation that can refuse, and no reachable path from the running product.
notes: No online RL is authorized, and no exploration in production. Action::Explore exists in accepted code and must stay unreachable from the live router.
The DecisionDistribution gate is satisfied by the 7E-2A type, not by a calibrated producer: calibration is 7E-2D, so any distribution this node emits must be labeled uncalibrated.

Every production sample carries feedback None because no user-rating source exists, so the reward here is an outcome-derived proxy and never a user preference. A bandit optimizing that proxy can diverge from what a user would have preferred, which is a limitation to record rather than to average away.
ml/reward.rs and ml/coordinator.rs are accepted and read-only here; this node consumes them and adds a new module.
A mean-reward improvement that regresses the failure rate, the cost, or a tail latency percentile is not an improvement. The safety evaluation must be able to withhold acceptance on tail grounds.
No bandit, arm statistic, or fitting exists anywhere in ml/ yet, so this node is building the capability rather than repairing it.
